notes: kb/Work PB894. Both formats (PDF p310 rendered): Format 1's attribute group and Format 2's `PROGRAM-ID. program-prototype-name-1 [AS literal-1] IS PROTOTYPE .` are ALTERNATIVES of programIdParagraph, and the IS PROTOTYPE tail is the ONE prototypePhrase rule the FUNCTION-ID paragraph shares (IS unstressed, so optional — the golden writes `PGPR PROTOTYPE.`). Before PB894 Format 2 drew COBOL0901 on the reserved word. Format 2 is a COBOL-2002 introduction (program-prototype-2002; below it COBOL0900 from the bound arm). EDITIONS AS ADJUDICATED 2026-11-10: in force at 85 in part, Format 1 without AS literal-1 and RECURSIVE: §1985:VI.3.3.2 prints 'PROGRAM-ID. program-name.' and §1985:X.3.1.2 prints 'PROGRAM-ID. program-name' with the optional IS COMMON and/or INITIAL PROGRAM attribute group (choice indicators) before the period; AS literal-1, RECURSIVE and Format 2 (prototype) are not 1985 syntax.
